official.domain-heading: Ofitsialnyye sayty GFTV zakanchivayutsya na globalfurry.tv ili gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Chitayte adres s kontsa: smotrite na poslednyuyu tochku pered pervoy odinochnoy kosoy chertoy. Sayt, kotory zakanchivayetsya chem-to drugim, ne prinadlezhit GFTV, dazhe yesli eto nazvaniye vstrechayetsya v adrese ranshe.
official.secure-body: Ishchite znachok zamka ili https:// v nachale adresa. Soobshchayte lichnyye dannyye tolko na ofitsialnom sayte cherez zashchishchyonnoye soyedineniye.

about.title: Globalnoye furri-televideniye
about.body-1: Globalnoye furri-televideniye (GFTV) — krupneyshiy novostnoy kanal furri-fendoma v Azii, baziruyushchiysya v Singapure.
about.body-2: My pokazyvayem, kak rastyot furri-soobshchestvo, chtoby kazhdy mog otsenit eto segodnya i zavtra, i sozdayom prostranstva, gde lyudi mogut uznat i ponyat drug druga.
about.body-3: Komanda GFTV, kotoraya iz rodnogo doma okhvatyvayet krupneyshiye kontinenty, — mezhdunarodnaya, mnogokulturnaya i mnogoyazychnaya.
